caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wrought iron gate or window grille, vertically oriented, with a slight curvature that suggests it projects outward from a wall. The structure is composed of vertical bars with horizontal supports on the top and bottom, both of which are slightly curved. Each vertical bar features small, symmetrical decorative elements that resemble fleurs-de-lis or ornate scrolls, regularly spaced along their height. At the top center of the structure, there is a larger, more elaborate flourish that extends above the frame, also reminiscent of a fleur-de-lis. The colors used are mainly dark brown and black, giving the appearance of aged or weathered iron. The background is plain off-white, with no other objects or contextual details present. The signature "W. Kierkhazel" is located in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Iron Grille at Window: Restoration Drawing
